title: OTC index option term sheet extraction schema, v1 (v0.2 CS3)
description: Same contract as termsheet_v1: every field EXTRACTED with a verbatim citation or DECLARED_ABSENT. product_type otc_option. Cross-field relations are deterministic comparator rules listed under `relations`.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.description: Transaction reference as printed (e.g. 'OP-2026-0114').

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Legal name of the option buyer (Party B).

fields.name: seller
fields.description: Legal name of the option seller (Party A).

fields.name: option_style
fields.description: Exercise style.

fields.name: option_type
fields.description: Call or put.

fields.name: underlyings
fields.description: Bloomberg ticker(s) of the underlying index, e.g. ['BVERSA10'].

fields.name: notional
fields.description: Notional Amount, numeric.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency of the Notional Amount.

fields.name: trade_date
fields.description: Trade Date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Effective Date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: strike_level_pct
fields.description: Strike Level as percent of the Initial Index Level.

fields.name: participation_rate_pct
fields.description: Participation Rate in percent.

fields.name: valuation_date
fields.description: Valuation Date (final observation), ISO-8601.

fields.name: expiration_date
fields.description: Expiration Date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: automatic_exercise
fields.description: True if Automatic Exercise is applicable.

fields.name: premium_pct
fields.description: Premium as percent of the Notional Amount.

fields.name: premium_amount
fields.description: Premium amount in currency, numeric, as printed.

fields.name: premium_payment_date
fields.description: Premium Payment Date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: cash_settlement_days
fields.description: Number of Currency Business Days after the Valuation Date on which cash settlement is paid ('Three' -> 3).

fields.name: settlement_currency
fields.description: Settlement Currency.

fields.name: calculation_agent
fields.description: Calculation Agent as named ('Party A' or a legal name).

fields.name: index_administrator
fields.description: Administrator of the underlying index as named in the document's Underlying Index section (e.g. 'Bloomberg Index Services Limited'). ABSENT if the document has no such section.

fields.name: index_return_type
fields.description: The methodology return type cited for the underlying index ('Type I under the Index Methodology' -> type_i). ABSENT if not stated.

fields.name: index_return_treatment
fields.description: Return treatment stated for the underlying index: 'Excess Return' or 'Total Return'. ABSENT if not stated.

fields.name: index_vol_target_pct
fields.description: Volatility Target of the underlying index in percent per annum, as stated. ABSENT if not stated.

fields.name: index_rebalance_frequency
fields.description: Rebalancing cadence stated for the underlying index ('Each Index Business Day' -> daily). ABSENT if not stated.

fields.name: index_deduction_factor_pct
fields.description: Deduction Factor in percent per annum, as stated. ABSENT if not stated.

fields.name: index_transaction_cost_rate_pct
fields.description: Transaction Cost Rate in percent, as stated. ABSENT if not stated.

relations.name: premium_arithmetic
relations.description: premium_pct × notional must equal premium_amount within one cent, on the term sheet AND on the booking. A booked premium computed off the wrong notional violates it.

history.note: Initial; fields from V2-CHANGES CS3 and the approved OP-2026-0114 template.
Same day: added the 7 index_* Underlying Index fields (CS4).
